summary: One row in a Menu. A real <button> inside an <li>, with an optional leading icon and a trailing selected check.
useWhen: a row in a Menu surface

useInstead.when: it is a top-level navigation destination
it is a standalone action outside a list

icon.note: leading icon; omit its `label` — the row's text names it

guarantees: `isSelected` sets `aria-pressed`, so the selected state is announced and not only drawn
the check glyph always occupies its slot, so rows never reflow as the selection moves

antiPatterns.why: it renders an <li>, which is only valid inside a list

antiPatterns.dont: an icon-only MenuItem with no children
